reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the issue #88a description fix: 54 records edited in place (44 models, 10 pipelines) and 94 batch records (54 metadata-correction claims, 40 sources). Diff checked against origin/main; every description read against its cited source text; all 42 originally pinned source artifacts re-downloaded and hash-checked. See review.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review.
Ten Europe PMC search responses no longer reproduce their pinned bytes because the API changes JSON key order; their content was compared with the collector's saved copies, which match the pins.
Descriptions were checked against abstracts and cited sections, not whole papers, except where full text was the cited source.
The checkpoints quoted in MIMIC Table S11 are not identified, so the pipeline descriptions stay at family level.

tests/omics-evidence-completion.test.ts fails once the batch is added because it takes the first metadata-correction record instead of metadata-correction-6ff08f49b3b45f847dd6; the test was not edited.
The full data build was not run.

errors.message: Descriptions named or implied a checkpoint, size or variant that the record does not identify; reworded to family level and, for AIDO Protein-RAG, the ProteinGym README row added as a source.
Wording went beyond the cited text (architecture not named in the abstract, 'translation rate', 'protein sequences'); changed to the source's terms.
Duplicated existing store sources; replaced by run-doc-proteingym-readme-md-144fe22b and expansion-p3-mrnabench-2025 and removed from the batch.
Licence left unreported although the arXiv abstract page or the bioRxiv/medRxiv API states it; set from those statements.
Left unchanged by the collector, but the mRNABench full text (expansion-p3-mrnabench-2025) describes the baseline; suggested description in review.md.
